overview: BuildTrack is a real-time construction management platform that helps companies track materials, manage budgets, and generate invoices across multiple sites. Project managers, site engineers, and finance teams all get role-appropriate dashboards with live inventory levels, budget vs actual spending, and automated invoice generation.
features: Real-time inventory tracking with QR code scanning
Role-based access for managers, engineers, and finance teams
Alerts for low inventory and budget overruns
